narr: An upper level disturbance slowly moved across Louisiana allowing for scattered showers and storms to develop during the afternoons of mid-August. The slow motion and high rain rate produced flooding in Alexandria.
ev: Portions of Jackson Street and Versailles Boulevard flooded during heavy rain with several cars stalled.
lsr: Public reports Jackson St Extension is inundated with water. Several cars are stalled.
Parish 911 center reports several cars stranded due to street flooding in the Jackson St and Versailles Boulevard areas.
